**Author:** HedgeAlgo 🇺🇸 (@MarginCall4) · 2026-08-27

## Summary
One week of iteration took the "Milk" SPX option strategy from v1.0 to v1.1, and it is now **live** (real money), with v2.0 planned. The changelog doubles as a pre-live hardening checklist:

- added / corrected data
- replaced assumed margins with **actual broker margins**
- stress-tested scenarios **not found in historical data**
- actively tried to **break** the strategy (adversarial search)
- made it runnable in **IRAs** (tax-advantaged accounts)
- ironed out **execution frictions**

## Why it matters
- This is a reusable go-live checklist for any backtested system: data integrity → real-world margins → synthetic stress → try-to-break-it → account-type fit → friction cleanup.
- "Find scenarios to break it" and "stress cases not in historical data" are the two steps most retail backtests skip.
